what-it-is.statement: A workload group selects cloud workloads by building an expression from tag types and key-value pairs, and is then used as a criterion in Internet & SaaS (ZIA) policies so that security policy applies to the workload traffic.

quotes: The Workload Group page enables you to create workload groups to apply security policies for your cloud workloads deployed on a public cloud service provider, such as the Amazon Web Services (AWS) platform.
You can create a workload group by building an expression using various tag types and key-value pairs.

You can use the workload group as a criterion in Internet & SaaS (ZIA) policies such as SSL/TLS Inspection, Firewall Filtering, URL Filtering, and DLP to apply security policies to the workload traffic.
You can define a workload group by building an expression using different tag types and key-value pairs in the Zscaler Admin Console.
A workload group is used to logically group all the workloads with user-defined tags and cloud service provider-defined attributes that align with the tag expression of that workload group.

cloud-metadata-source.statement: Membership comes from cloud-native metadata: workloads with user-defined tags and provider-defined attributes that match the group's expression belong to the group, and their traffic is forwarded by Cloud Connectors to the Zero Trust Exchange where the selected policies apply.

quotes: A workload group is used to logically group all the workloads with user-defined tags and cloud service provider-defined attributes that align with the tag expression of that workload group.
The workloads with user-defined tags and attributes that match the expression are considered a part of workload group A.
the traffic from the workloads under workload group A is forwarded by Cloud Connectors to the Zero Trust Exchange (ZTE), and the selected security policies are applied.
Leverage cloud-native metadata available on the public cloud to apply policies to workload traffic.

discovery-prerequisite.statement: The feature needs a subscription to a Workload SKU and a Cloud & Branch Connector account; after subscribing, Zscaler Support must enable the Workload Discovery Service Endpoint before Workload Groups can be used.

quotes: Ensure that your organization has a subscription to one of the Workload SKUs and an account with Cloud & Branch Connector in the Zscaler Admin Console. When subscribed, contact Zscaler Support to enable the Workload Discovery Service Endpoint to access the Workload Groups feature.

discovered-in-cloud-connector.statement: The deployed workloads and their discovered tags can be viewed on the Cloud & Branch Connector Partner Integrations page in the Admin Console.

quotes: You can view the deployed workloads and their respective tags discovered on the Cloud & Branch Connector Partner Integrations page in the Zscaler Admin Console.
You can view all the workloads and their respective tags in Cloud Connector in the Zscaler Admin Console.

edit-permission.statement: Only admins with full policy access can add or edit workload groups.

quotes: Only admins with full policy access can add or edit the workload groups.

both-fields.statement: The Terraform rule resources that carry `workload_groups` also carry `location_groups`, so a rule can scope by both.
